Location, direction, buildings, and spatial reference

Movement, transport, weather, and the environment

The body, ordinary functions, and sensory experience

Work, tools, machines, exchange, and responsibilities

Arrange a sentence about making, repairing, using, buying, or selling.
Public life, institutions, services, and shared spaces
Match public places, institutions, roles, and shared-service words to approved meanings.

Information, computation, systems, science, and observation
Match data, system, observation, astronomy, and science terms to approved meanings.
Arrange a sentence about information, a system, or scientific observation.
Understanding, emotion, humor, performance, and conversation
Match understanding, emotion, humor, and performance words to approved meanings.
Arrange a sentence about explanation, feeling, humor, music, or performance.
Conditions, clauses, comparisons, modality, and advanced pronouns
Identify approved condition, clause, comparison, modality, and advanced-pronoun forms.
Restore the approved order and markers in a sentence with more than one grammatical relationship.
National voice, dialogue choices, idioms, and figurative meaning
Match national, ceremonial, dialogue, and idiomatic forms to approved meanings.
Choose or repair a sentence so its form fits the recorded regional or social voice.
